title: AI agents and memory costs reshape how we sell PCs online
summary: Half of holiday shoppers plan to use AI (NRF); Walmart opened Black Friday deals to Meta's AI agent; Klarna joined Adyen's agent checkout; agents recommend out-of-stock items. HP and Dell expect memory prices to rise through 2027.

points.headline: AI agents are becoming a deal and checkout channel, but data lags
points.detail: Half of holiday shoppers plan to use AI (NRF); Walmart opened Black Friday to Meta’s agent; agents recommend out-of-stock items; Shopify added chargeback evidence for agentic orders. Our feeds and stock must be agent-ready.

points.headline: Memory costs keep PC prices rising into 2027 while demand stays soft
points.detail: HP and Dell expect memory prices to keep rising in 2027 with a weak PC market; European notebook revenue rose 16% on pricier models. We should plan pricing, mix and promotions for price pressure.

points.headline: AI PCs and gaming are absorbing higher prices at HP and Best Buy
points.detail: HP says local AI demand lifts AI PC shipments past expectations, and Best Buy computing sales held on gaming and AI demand. We should check AI PC and gaming merchandising online.

points.headline: Online holiday demand is strong, with small businesses spending more
points.detail: Adobe reports online holiday spending up 9.1% and Amex projects a 14-year high in small-business holiday spending. Value and financing offers should lead our holiday and business promotions.
